visual_identity.core_identity: An apparently decorative floor rug animated into a flexible constricting sheet that wraps victims with no face or limbs.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large rectangular textile lifting in a curling wave, corners and edges folding around a central victim.
visual_identity.head_features: No head, eyes, or mouth; menace comes from folding motion.
visual_identity.body_shape: Flat woven rectangle capable of bending, rolling, and wrapping while keeping identifiable rug edges.
visual_identity.surface: Broad simple geometric or heraldic pattern with large colorable areas, fringe kept sparse.
